verdict.rationale: Statsig documents a Console API, a CRUD API for every action available in the web console, plus an HTTP API for evaluating gates, experiments and configs and logging events without an SDK. Together these let a user drive the product programmatically. The evidence is brief single-line overviews: probes found no OpenAPI spec at the standard paths, and no independent or hands-on report confirms API use. missing for 10: machine-readable OpenAPI spec, documented depth on endpoints, auth and limits, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: The Console API is the CRUD API for performing the actions available on console.statsig.com without using the web UI.
Overview of the Statsig HTTP API for retrieving feature gate, experiment, and dynamic config values and logging events directly without an SDK.
